review: Make Masks mask layers (2026-10-25): any number of mask folders drawn as coloured outlines, one editable curated overlay copied from the base layer, the Pick tool that removes, restores (dashed outline) and adds objects with new ids, and the save-folder control (new mask folder by default, a layer folder only after the in-page Overwrite confirmation). Preserve every placeholder ({id}, {layer}, {name}, {path}, {current}) and the ellipsis.

records.key: Add a folder of label masks matched to these images by stem. Each layer is drawn as outlines in its own colour; an editable curated overlay starts as a copy of the first layer and is saved to a new mask folder.
records.source: Add a folder of label masks matched to these images by stem. Each layer is drawn as outlines in its own colour; an editable curated overlay starts as a copy of the first layer and is saved to a new mask folder.
records.translation: Ajoute un dossier de masques d’étiquettes associés à ces images par racine de nom. Chaque calque est dessiné sous forme de contours dans sa propre couleur ; une superposition curée modifiable commence comme copie du premier calque et est enregistrée dans un nouveau dossier de masques.

records.source: Pick: click an object of the curated overlay to remove it; a removed base object is drawn dashed, and a second click restores it. Click an object of another layer to add it with a new id; it fills only background. Hidden layers are not picked from.
records.translation: Choisir : cliquez sur un objet de la superposition curée pour le retirer ; un objet de base retiré est dessiné en pointillés, et un second clic le rétablit. Cliquez sur un objet d’un autre calque pour l’ajouter avec un nouvel id ; il ne remplit que l’arrière-plan. Les objets des calques cachés ne peuvent pas être choisis.
